images.alt: Timeline of the custom GPT retirement: no new GPTs on personal accounts, workspace building ends October 26, 2026, all GPTs stop December 11.
images.caption: Personal accounts are already locked out of creating GPTs, and every GPT has an end date.
images.note: Check OpenAI's retirement FAQ directly; the rollout is still moving

items.label: Personal accounts
items.text: Can no longer create or publish new GPTs

items.label: October 26, 2026
items.text: Business, Enterprise and Edu workspaces stop building them

items.label: February 2027
items.text: Extension available to a few Enterprise workspaces

images.after: Setup 2: a public helper that answers from your guides
images.title: Before you share a public helper
images.alt: Checklist for a public blog helper: upload only public guides, add a guide index file, limit answers to your guides, test in a private window.
images.caption: Anyone you share a Gem with can view its instructions and uploaded files.

items: Add one file with each guide's title, URL and short summary
Include the full text of your ten or so most-read guides
Tell it to answer only from the uploaded guides
Open the link in a private window to see what readers see
Ask ten real reader questions and check every answer

images.title: Limits to know before you share
images.alt: Five limits of blog AI assistants: invented facts, shared files aren't private, data settings, unedited output and stale files.
images.caption: Launch the private assistant first; a public one's mistakes reach readers with your name on them.

items.title: It still makes things up
items.text: Reference files reduce invented facts but don't stop them.

items.title: Shared files aren't secret
items.text: No paid ebooks, drafts, client work, logins or API keys.

items.title: Check the data settings
items.text: Review each tool's privacy settings before you upload a draft.

items.title: Don't publish it unedited
items.text: An outline is a starting point, not a finished post.

items.title: Stale files, stale answers
items.text: When you update a guide, replace its file.
